title: Route POST /api/crypto/score through UAI and the canonical ScoringModelRegistry
invariants: POST /api/crypto/score resolves a UAI identity before model execution
only the canonical champion returned by ScoringModelRegistry may authorize execution
the consumer fails closed if executor binding, evidence policy or result contract is incompatible
existing verified market-data evidence gates remain authoritative
score math, ranking thresholds and eligibility semantics are unchanged
model registry metadata is added to scoring lineage
Gemini Research Shadow remains disabled and has no score impact
nonGoals: do not migrate /api/crypto/list or /api/crypto/top10 in this work item
do not introduce the Phase-C single dispatcher yet
do not change scoring weights, ranking or eligibility
do not enable Gemini provider traffic
do not mutate Render, Supabase or Stripe
releaseCondition: Release coordination metadata when this work is merged, closed, superseded or abandoned.
